description: A breakpoint set before editor_run is in place from the game's first frame. The set is kept in the project until removed. The addon turns on network/debug_adapter/sync_breakpoints. A game this server started does not stop on a script error. Operations: set (needs scriptPath, line); remove (needs scriptPath, line): remove a breakpoint, whoever set it, the editor's gutter included; list: held breakpoints under held, and if this project's editor is connected its gutter under setInEditor.

line.description: One-based line. Not for op list.

pid.description: This server's game, by pid. Not for op list.

scriptPath.description: Script file inside the project, such as "scripts/player.gd". Not for op list.

name: debug_breakpoint
title: Breakpoints
